svg.title: 間 the breathing gap — a mark for artbitrage.io
svg.desc: An arched door in two leaves. The slit between them opens into a full round and closes again: the round is not drawn, it is the gap, and whatever is behind shows through. 閒, the old form of 間 (隙也。从門从月), is moonlight seen through the gap of a door. There's a space between looking and seeing. — artbitrage.io, art brings us closer.
